interpretation_notes: MedAE is minimized by the conditional median, so we used HGB with loss='absolute_error' (L1) as the primary model. Tuned a small 4-config grid via 5-fold CV, then blended with ExtraTrees; blend weight chosen by MedAE on OOF. Predictions clipped to observed train target range.
